lead.t: To enter the glycolytic pathway, galactose, mannose, fructose and glycerol are firstly converted to glucose-6-phosphate (or intermediates), fructose-6-phosphate, fructose-1-phosphate / fructose-6-phosphate, and dihydroxyacetone phosphate / glycerol-3-phosphate respectively.

snip.t: To enter the glycolytic pathway, galactose, mannose, fructose and glycerol are firstly converted to glucose-6-phosphate (or intermediates), fructose-6-phosphate, fructose-1-phosphate / fructose-6-phosphate, and dihydroxyacetone phosphate / glycerol-3-phosphate respectively.
Fructose --> Fructose-6-phosphate (E1) --> Fructose-1,6-bisphosphate (PFK-1) --> Dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DHAP) + Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate (E2: Fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase)
(a) Triose phosphate isomerase — Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate ⇌ Dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

imgs.a: Flowchart showing conversion of Fructose to Fructose 1-phosphate via E1, then into Glyceraldehyde + Dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DHAP) via E2
